translation: I once sunned a fine louse in the blazing sun, and it walked quickly and its vital qi became even more vigorous; this can prove the principle of yang giving birth and yin growing, circulating without end. Speaking of the great by means of the extremely small, then all things are born every day; how could words be exhausted? Someone says: Farmers sun themselves all day, why do they also have disease? I say: This is because they first have internal injury and then receive external influence; what fault is it of sunning? If after sunning one becomes strong and robust, wind and cold will not even invade; how could there be disease? Why does the self-cultivator not try it once? Do not be ungrateful for the sincerity of this rustic who warms his back and offers the sun.
